data.body: HANDOFF STATE 2026-11-12 (PST): plan review PASS (Bedrock); claimed; worktree .rebar/worktrees/phoebe-harness. RED tests written first and confirmed failing (overflow: 21 != 26; resume: 4 header cases exit 0 instead of 2; KeyError 'runner'). Fixes in engine_comparison.py: `_surfaced` reads overflow; `resume_mismatch` + `_load_resume` refuse a mismatched schema_version/corpus/corpus_digest/match_threshold with exit 2 and the field named; `_provenance` records runner, model and provider_provenance.ran_model; SCHEMA_VERSION 2. 27 tests pass, lint clean. Review advisories handled: (a) the verdict's `model` is the configured (verifier-class) model for the pipeline, so records also carry `ran_model` from provider_provenance; (b) a disposable store has no rebar.toml, so `AWS_PROFILE=frontier-bedrock` alone does NOT select Bedrock (measured: bare `claude-opus-5-5`); with REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE=.github/llm-providers/bedrock.toml it resolves `bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5`. docs/llm-framework.md's run command now sets the overlay. Not done: --resume does not compare runner/model (a resumed run can still mix providers; the per-record fields make it visible). Live re-run on Bedrock in progress, fresh, no --resume.
